name: MVP
summary: Ready to build the first working version. Adds a spec convention (/spec + FEAT-NNN with validated-learning + evals + failure-states fields), a stack-configured build gate (/smoke), evals discipline (/evals — Husain; v0.30 requires failure-mode categories for AI-mediated FEATs), demand-testing discipline (/pretotype — Savoia), JIT design-tokens scaffolding (/design-tokens-init — Frost / Curtis), AI cost discipline (/ai-cost — cohort-aware budgets + per-call logger; v0.25) + cost review cadence (/cost-review reads the ledger; v0.30), the AI-first template (/ai-first-init conductor + /ai-failure-states for the five failure modes with Eval-tested fields; v0.26+v0.30 — bakes in eval + cost + schema + failure-state design from day one), the extraction discipline (/extract + extraction-loop encoding PRINCIPLE #1's UP/DOWN router via LLM-as-judge; v0.29), the deep whole-project drift audit (/drift-deep — the 1M-context 'am I fooling myself across everything' counterpart to the cheap drift hook moment; v0.37), the revalidation gate (/revalidate — the 3-line 'still relevant? still aligned? anything changed?' check before paused work re-enters build, so you never ship a zombie feature; ported UP from the dhun dogfood, v0.48), trace error-analysis (/judge-traces — Hamel/Shankar applied to your own `.boss/trace.jsonl`: read real session traces, sort failures into a binary taxonomy, route recurring modes to /boss-learn; the deliberate reader for the auto-log substrate, v0.53), the mentor board orchestrator (/consult — convene the mentors who have a stake in a cross-cutting question, get each lens in its own voice, synthesize with the disagreement kept visible and the humane override; advisory only; IDEA-022 Track 2, v0.57), the shared craft commons (/practice — capture a better way to build with AI as a shared, attributed, staleness-aware PRAC-NNN your cofounder gets too, so the team stays current on the fast-moving agentic-AI craft together instead of re-learning it; v0.78, IDEA-037 slice 4), the deploy/reachability discipline (/ship — the CD half of building: detect the stack, run a deploy-time pre-flight against the signature vibe-coded-leak surface (no client-bundled secrets; server-side authz/RLS actually on — CVE-2025-48757/MoltBook), pick the cheapest reversible host, hand back the live URL + the rollback path; stack-neutral, the pre-flight is a check not a gate; v0.92, FEAT-024), the first-landing-page generator (/landing — compose BRAND.md voice/positioning + design tokens + the canvas Promises cell into an on-brand first page, humane-checked so it converts honestly (no fake urgency/confirmshaming), then hand to /ship; product-page vs demand-page = /pretotype's fake door; generates the simple on-brand case, hands off CMS/visual-editing to Framer/Carrd; v0.112, get-it-out-the-block-not-a-CRO-tool), the post-ship measurement runner (/measure — the /pretotype counterpart: pick ONE activation metric + ONE retention curve, ≤10 events, add the AI-product metrics classic analytics misses (task-completion rate, edit-rate, cost-per-successful-outcome), free/OSS/no-lock-in; humane by construction — measures graduation not engagement, says 'go talk to your users' at n<10; v0.113), the product-market-fit verdict (/pmf-check — the one gate the post-launch journey turns on: reads what BOSS already holds and renders pre/at/post-PMF from Sean-Ellis-40% + retention-curve flattening + pull-vs-push, DEFAULTS to 'you're probably still pre-PMF, keep talking to users, don't scale yet' because premature scaling is the #1 startup killer; voiced through the seller→operator→leader role ladder — it names the job you're in and says no to the leader's job before the operator's; a verdict not a dashboard, says 'go talk to them' at n<10; v0.120), the decaying-curve doctor (/retain — the fixing half /measure's reading half was missing: rebase past the week-2-5 AI-tourist wave to the Month-3 cohort, then diagnose WHERE the curve dies — top=activation-failure→/onboard, middle=engagement-decay→product+roadmap+/interview-the-churned, wallet=involuntary/card-failure→dunning-plumbing-point-at-Stripe; there is no retention hack, the fix is always the product, this says which part; humane — a graduated user is a win, resurrection=invitation not winback-dark-pattern; refuses churn-ML/dashboards/streaks; v0.121, library/practices/retention.md), the activation designer (/onboard — the top-of-curve fix /retain routes to: derive the aha-moment from data (best-retained vs churned cohort, not a whiteboard guess), shrink time-to-value (cut every step signup→value; seed a 'magic first run' so the first AI output is good before the user works), and run concierge onboarding BY HAND for the first users (Superhuman / do-things-that-don't-scale — it doubles as /interview); humane — activation = getting them to SUCCESS fast not HOOKED fast, refuses fake-progress/gamified/forced-tutorial dark patterns; activation > acquisition, the highest-leverage funnel number; v0.122, library/practices/activation.md), the what-to-build-next weigher (/roadmap — the fuller version of /spec's loud≠important check: weigh feedback vs behavior into a SMALL Shape-Up bet-list + a mandatory NO-list, Confidence=the EVID grade (Gilad's meter on BOSS's ladder), RICE-reach OFF by default, behavior outranks requests, pre-PMF the roadmap is just 'find fit'; a snapshot you use and discard, NOT a Gantt/backlog you tend; humane — serves the silent majority not whoever shouts; v0.123), the first-paying-customer runner (/first-dollar — IDEA-050: fires when someone has actually said yes and walks five deferrable moves (entity / ToS+privacy / payment rail = cheapest-reversible payment-link-before-billing-system / refund posture / the first price said out loud), detects+skips what exists, ends by writing the commitment-grade EVID so the first dollar doesn't evaporate; bright line — pointers to professionals never legal/tax advice, records the EVENT not the STREAM (no MRR dashboard); the conscience shifts validate→deliver once first revenue exists; v0.125, library/practices/first-dollar.md), a devlog (/log), and a session-end ritual (/close + RESUME.md). Builders: tester + program-manager. Mentors: architect + GTM + cofounder (the founding-team relationship — coaches a TEAM on working together across skill sets, the non-tech↔eng cofounder gap, and the hard conversations; never takes a side; v0.79, IDEA-037 slice 5). Plus 8 named loops on the v0.18 primitive — spec-loop (moment #4 restraint), pretotype-loop (Savoia), design-tokens-loop (IDEA-010), cost-budget-loop (Husain-applied-to-spend; v0.25), ai-failure-state-loop (Husain failure-mode discipline applied to UX; v0.26), extraction-loop (PRINCIPLE #1's own discipline; v0.29), cost-review-loop (the cadence /ai-cost only declared; v0.30), drift-loop (work-vs-named-risk — the closest loop to why BOSS exists; predicate-gated model judgment, v0.31), and margin-trap-loop (the post-launch cost→price bridge — fires when there's a real cost ledger + a cost review but none has looked at the margin; the model judges cost-per-active-user vs your price AND the humane profit-from-struggle read on retries/regenerations; a16z/Tunguz + PRINCIPLE #6, v0.118).
graduationHint: When you have real users and the app needs design rigor, a real db, and prototypes — boss unlock v1.
